Potato, Poodle,or a Pool Noodle?

Players2–8
Time15–30 min

Overview

In this co-op party game, the Guessing Player must figure out a Secret Word by asking which 3 things it’s closest to. The rest of the table answers, and they also add another clue every time!

Components

  • ~250 Word Cards
  • Potato Track & Poodle Meeple
  • Clue Menu Card

Setup

  • Place 10 random Word Cards onto the designated spot on the Potato Track.
  • Place the Poodle Meeple on the #1 spot.
  • Select the first Guessing Player - whoever most recently ate a potato (tie-breaker is more recently petting a poodle).
  • Hand the first Answering Player (next player clockwise) the Clue Menu.

Clue Menu

Turn Structure

  • Show all players, except the Guessing Player, the next Word
  • The Guessing Player asks “Is the word closer to a Potato, a Poodle, or a Pool Noodle?” as their first question.
  • The Answering Player answers, “It’s closer to <Choice>, but…” and adds a Clue they’d like to give from the Clue Menu, filling out the blanks as they see fit (with some basic restrictions: no using parts of the word, rhyming, “starts with A”, etc.)
  • Examples: “It’s closer to a Potato but has seeds”, “It’s closer to a Poodle but has more legs”, “It’s closer to a Pool Noodle but found at the circus”, and so on. Get creative!
  • The Answering Player role then moves clockwise (skipping the Guessing Player, of course, if it gets to them)
  • The Guessing Player gets to ask for more clues in the format “Is the word closer to <Word 1>, <Word 2>, or <Word 3>?” where the <Words> are what they think the Secret Word might be closer to.
  • So when do they get to guess? They don’t directly - instead, they use their suspected answer as one of their three words! Example: “Is it closer to an eagle, or..” “It’s an eagle!”
  • Continue until the Guessing Player says the Word or Gives Up their turn.

Scoring

3 pts≤ 3 clues
2 pts4–5 clues
1 pt6+ clues

As this is a co-op game, the score for everyone is determined by the number of clues given before the correct guess. If the Guessing Player needed Three Clues or fewer, they earn 3 points, if they needed Four to Five Clues, they earn 2 points, and any correct guess after earns 1 point.

The points are tracked by moving the Poodle Meeple on the Potato Track, which also has some achievement thresholds marked off. Is your group “Party Poodles”, “Hot Potatoes”, or can you go all the way to “Poodles with Potato Noodles”? Find out after all 10 Word Cards are played!
